videos.title: Mastering The Rubber Guard by Eddie Bravo
videos.whyUseful: Eddie Bravo himself walks through the Rubber Guard system: the overhook, the posture break, Mission Control, and how the control positions lead into the submission chain. The authoritative primary reference for the system from its creator.

videos.title: Rubber Guard 101: Zombie, New York, Chill Dog, Jiu Claw (omoplata)
videos.whyUseful: Explains what the Rubber Guard position names mean and shows the basic setup step by step, including how Mission Control and New York lead to the Chill Dog and the Omoplata. Useful for learning the sequence names used across the system.

videos.title: Rubber Guard (Chill dog) seminar at The Den Kings Lynn
videos.whyUseful: A 10th Planet seminar covering the Chill Dog control and the kung fu move used to re-clamp the arm when the opponent defends, with the transitions that follow from it.
